biotools.summary: stdpopsim is a simulation library extending population genetics models to incorporate realistic selection and demographic histories. It enables simulations of various selection modes, including background selection and selective sweeps, making it a powerful resource for benchmarking statistical methods and exploring evolutionary predictions.
